scenes.spoken_text: A finished face is only one part of the specification. Identify the core, facing, edge treatment and visible surfaces, then approve a representative sample.
scenes.caption: A finished face is only one part of the specification. Identify the core, facing, edge treatment and visible surfaces, then approve a representative sample.

scenes.spoken_text: Identify the core and product code, then the facing or paint-ready substrate and final finish. State colour and sheen without using them as a description of the build-up. Check the selected system’s requirements for the back and edges rather than assuming every surface is treated alike.
scenes.caption: Core, facing and final finish are separate specification items.

scenes.display_title: Identify visible faces and edge treatments
scenes.spoken_text: Tag the part faces and edges in drawings and schedules. Specify visible edges, their treatment and stated dimensions. Declare whether scheduled sizes are finished or pre-treatment. Calculate edge effects for the agreed system instead of applying an arbitrary deduction, and record facing direction where it affects the appearance.
scenes.caption: Edge treatment links to the part identity and dimension stage.

scenes.spoken_text: Request a sample containing core, face and edge in the proposed system. Review it under lighting relevant to the site and record its code, colour, sheen, facing direction and decision. A face-only sample does not demonstrate the edge junction. Revisit approval whenever a material or finish is substituted.
scenes.caption: The sample shows the face-to-edge junction as well as colour.

scenes.spoken_text: A light-coloured shelf has a side edge visible from the entrance. The specification names only the colour, and the supplier provides a face-only sample. The complete appearance remains unconfirmed. Decision: define the visible edge treatment and review a face-to-edge sample before approving the system.
scenes.caption: Decision: define the visible edge treatment and review a face-to-edge sample before approving the system.
